orgs.name: DOMESTIC VIOLENCE CENTER OF CHESTER COUNTY
services: 24/7 free, confidential hotline (888-711-6270 / 610-431-1430) and safety planning
emergency shelter and transitional housing programs for domestic-violence survivors (incl. transitional housing in Oxford and Kennett Square)
legal advocacy, court accompaniment, and legal advice/representation in Protection from Abuse, custody, divorce and support matters
counseling services, support groups, children's programs and counseling, rapid response, bilingual (Spanish/English) services, community education and training
orgs.serves: survivors of domestic violence and their children in Chester County, PA

orgs.name: FRIENDS ASSOCIATION FOR CARE & PROTECTION OF CHILDREN
services: Emergency Family Shelter — the only publicly funded, low-barrier emergency family shelter in Chester County that keeps families of any makeup together (Family Center apartments, West Chester)
Eviction Prevention Case Resolution (EPCR) — free legal services, case management and financial assistance for families and individuals facing eviction
Housing Stability Case Management for families at risk of or experiencing homelessness; Chester County ERAP administration partner (county ERAP relaunch release, Dec 2022)
orgs.serves: families with children experiencing or at risk of homelessness in Chester County, PA

orgs.name: NORTH STAR OF CHESTER COUNTY
services: rental assistance paid directly to landlords for working single-parent families at risk of homelessness — more than half of participant families receive rental assistance, for up to three years (PHARE award, $50,000)
structured case management, budget counseling and financial mentorship toward financial independence; children's program funding, gas and grocery gift cards, and office pantry access
orgs.serves: working single parents with dependent children in Chester County, PA

orgs.name: OPEN HEARTH INC
services: housing programs to end the cycle of homelessness and help people acquire affordable housing — including its Continuum of Care Permanent Supportive Housing program providing rental and utility assistance plus supportive services to approx. 72 households a year (PHARE award, $80,000)
financial management programs — money management and financial-stability coaching
transportation programs — help acquiring a means of transportation
workforce opportunities support (org mission statement, own site)
orgs.serves: at-risk populations, low-income households, people with disabilities, single parents, the elderly, and individuals and families experiencing homelessness in Chester County and Western Montgomery County, PA

orgs.name: SAFE HARBOR OF CHESTER COUNTY INC
services: emergency shelter for 20 single men and 20 single women experiencing homelessness (20 N Matlack St, West Chester) — a low-demand shelter; access via 2-1-1 / ConnectPoints
meals — breakfast and dinner for residents and a weekday Community Lunch Program for low- and no-income community members; hygiene facilities and personal hygiene supplies

on-site counseling and case management (Resident Success Program), life-skills training, job-training referral and employment-placement counseling, and access to health, financial and legal aid services
orgs.serves: single men and women experiencing homelessness in Chester County, PA
